_about: The GM's trivia bank for the hosted Trivia duel (SPEC.md › PvP: the Challenge Wheel). Each question: id, q, options (four), answer (index into options). The GM console may append to this list per room through CHALLENGE_LIST { trivia: [...] }; hosted.js draws challenge.triviaQuestions of them per duel from the seeded 'challenge' stream.
